purpose: A whole-video transcription killed after its first checkpoint and a context reset: job status, then job resume of the same job; no second transcription.

phases.prompt: Your previous context was lost while a transcription of {{video}} was running. This is the resume card you saved: {{prepared_resume_card}} Continue the investigation: what error does the page show? Use the VSift skill and the compact budget. When you have written the handoff, keep the evidence: I authorise you to retain the session to a new folder named {{bundle_dir}} in this directory with vsift session retain (without the video), and then leave the session open.
